title: Yolk of 1 egg
instructions: String the beans and parboil them in salted, boiling water. Drain, cut into inch pieces, and season with butter,

salt, and pepper. Beat the egg yolk in a saucepan. Beat in flour and lemon juice, add the stock ( cold water will do), and cook the mixture over a moderate fire until it thickens. Pour over the hot beans and let remain over the fire a moment, so that they will absorb the flavor of the sauce, but not long enough to curdle the egg.
Sformato di Fagiuolini o Piselli (Mold of Peas or Beans)
